dct_title_s: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM) Drone imagery and GIS package by camp (June 2018)
dct_description_sm: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights. The package of June 2018 is based on [NPM Baseline Assessment 11](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-bangladesh-needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-round-11-site-assessment) (as of 14 June) and NPM most updated drone imagery (as of 21 June). Here below, the complete package by camp: - SW Map package - KMZ file - Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this [link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-npm-cox-bazar-uav-imagery).
